data.narrative:
Impulse Space is a SPAC-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Tom Mueller, currently valued at $4.26B following $1.525B in total capital raised. The valuation analysis draws from a universe of 13 comparable companies—5 public and 8 private—spanning similar-stage and same-sector operators including ICEYE ($12.0B Series F), Sierra Space ($8.0B Series C), Planet Labs ($7.6B public), and Firefly Aerospace ($2.9B public).

The peer-median method is applicable and yields a central valuation of $2.1B across 10 same-sector, similar-valuation-tier peers. This cohort spans a range of $1.1B to $12.0B, reflecting substantial dispersion driven by differences in stage, technology maturity, and revenue scale. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples cannot be applied; while the Space & Aerospace sector median trades at 26.4x revenue across 6 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL), Impulse Space's revenue is not disclosed, precluding multiple-based cross-checks typical of mature comparables.

The triangulated range—constrained by the single applicable method—centers on $2.1B (median), with a low-to-high band of $1.8B to $2.5B. The current $4.26B valuation sits materially above peer medians. Key uncertainties include undisclosed revenue, absence of profitability metrics, and the wide valuation dispersion among public and late-stage private peers, which limits confidence in point estimates within this sector.
